submission.summary:
Reviewed all 17 panel patients; all were on a DOAC for nonvalvular AF (no valvular/mechanical-valve indications found). Cockcroft-Gault CrCl calculated from current age, actual body weight and most recent creatinine; interacting meds reviewed.

CHANGED (13):
- pt-2001 Brooks: CrCl ~161 (62y, 104kg, Cr 0.7). Edoxaban is not to be used in NVAF when CrCl >95 (boxed warning) — stopped edoxaban 60 mg daily, started apixaban 5 mg BID (no reduction criteria met).
- pt-2002 Raman: CrCl ~29 — rivaroxaban 20 -> 15 mg daily.
- pt-2003 Novak: CrCl ~40 + dronedarone (P-gp inhibitor) — dabigatran 150 -> 75 mg BID.
- pt-2004 Greene: only 1 of 3 Eliquis criteria (81y; 88kg; current Cr 1.2) — apixaban 2.5 -> 5 mg BID.
- pt-2007 Castillo: on itraconazole (strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitor) — apixaban 5 -> 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2008 Hale: on clarithromycin (strong dual inhibitor) — apixaban 5 -> 2.5 mg BID; should return to 5 mg BID when the antibiotic course ends.
- pt-2009 Soto: CrCl ~25 (CKD 4) — dabigatran 150 -> 75 mg BID.
- pt-2011 Whitfield: CrCl ~39 — edoxaban 60 -> 30 mg daily.
- pt-2012 Mercer: CrCl ~75, underdosed — rivaroxaban 15 -> 20 mg daily (with evening meal).
- pt-2014 Rhodes: CrCl ~67, underdosed (the 75 mg dronedarone adjustment applies only at CrCl 30-50) — dabigatran 75 -> 150 mg BID.
- pt-2015 Lindqvist: only 1 of 3 criteria (79y, 58kg, Cr 1.0) — apixaban 2.5 -> 5 mg BID.
- pt-2016 Quinn: 2 of 3 criteria (82y, 125 lb = 56.7 kg) — apixaban 5 -> 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2017 Doyle: CrCl ~44 — rivaroxaban 20 -> 15 mg daily.

NO CHANGE (4): pt-2005 Voss (apixaban 2.5 BID correct: age 83 + 57 kg), pt-2006 Lee (rivaroxaban 20 mg, CrCl ~89), pt-2010 Tran (edoxaban 60 mg, CrCl ~92, <=95), pt-2013 Ward (edoxaban 60 mg, CrCl ~75; the <=60 kg reduction applies only to the DVT/PE indication, not NVAF).

No other medications were altered.

DOAC dose review for all 17 panel patients on a DOAC for nonvalvular AF (no valvular AF/mechanical valve documented). CrCl calculated by Cockcroft-Gault with most recent weight/creatinine; age as of 2026-10-01. Changes made (12 patients):
- pt-2001 Brooks: CrCl ~161 mL/min -> edoxaban not recommended >95 mL/min; stopped edoxaban 60 mg daily, started apixaban 5 mg BID (0 reduction criteria).
- pt-2002 Raman: CrCl ~29 -> rivaroxaban 20 mg -> 15 mg daily.
- pt-2003 Novak: CrCl ~40 + dronedarone (P-gp inhibitor) -> dabigatran 150 mg BID -> 75 mg BID.
- pt-2004 Greene: only 1 apixaban reduction criterion (age 81; 88 kg, Cr 1.2) -> apixaban 2.5 -> 5 mg BID.
- pt-2007 Castillo: on itraconazole (strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitor) -> apixaban 5 -> 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2009 Soto: CrCl ~25 -> dabigatran 150 -> 75 mg BID.
- pt-2011 Whitfield: CrCl ~39 -> edoxaban 60 -> 30 mg daily.
- pt-2012 Mercer: CrCl ~75 -> rivaroxaban 15 -> 20 mg daily (underdosed).
- pt-2014 Rhodes: CrCl ~67 -> dabigatran 75 -> 150 mg BID (dronedarone reduction applies only at CrCl 30-50).
- pt-2015 Lindqvist: only 1 criterion (58 kg; age 79, Cr 1.0) -> apixaban 2.5 -> 5 mg BID.
- pt-2016 Quinn: age 82 and 125 lb (56.7 kg) = 2 criteria -> apixaban 5 -> 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2017 Doyle: CrCl ~44 -> rivaroxaban 20 -> 15 mg daily.
No change needed: pt-2005 (apixaban 2.5 BID, age 83 + 57 kg), pt-2006 (rivaroxaban 20 mg, CrCl ~89), pt-2008 (apixaban 5 mg BID; clarithromycin requires no apixaban dose adjustment per label), pt-2010 (edoxaban 60 mg, CrCl ~92), pt-2013 (edoxaban 60 mg, CrCl ~75; low weight is not an NVAF reduction criterion). No other medications were altered.

DOAC dose review for all 17 panel patients, all of whom carry an active nonvalvular AF diagnosis (I48.91) and an active DOAC. Doses were checked against the US FDA label using current age, most recent weight and serum creatinine (Cockcroft-Gault CrCl) and concomitant interacting drugs.

CHANGED (13 patients):
- pt-2001 Brooks (62y, 104kg, SCr 0.7, CrCl ~161): edoxaban not recommended for NVAF when CrCl >95 (reduced efficacy/ischemic stroke risk). Edoxaban 60 mg stopped; started apixaban 5 mg BID (no reduction criteria met).
- pt-2002 Raman (74y F, 52kg, SCr 1.4, CrCl ~29): rivaroxaban 20 mg -> 15 mg once daily with evening meal.
- pt-2003 Novak (78y, 78kg, SCr 1.7, CrCl ~40) on dronedarone: dabigatran 150 mg -> 75 mg BID (P-gp inhibitor with CrCl 30-50).
- pt-2004 Greene (81y, 88kg, current SCr 1.2): only 1 reduction criterion; apixaban 2.5 mg -> 5 mg BID (prior 2.5 mg was based on an older SCr of 1.6).
- pt-2007 Castillo on itraconazole: apixaban 5 mg -> 2.5 mg BID (strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitor).
- pt-2008 Hale on clarithromycin: apixaban 5 mg -> 2.5 mg BID (strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitor); should return to 5 mg BID once the antibiotic course finishes.
- pt-2009 Soto (75y, 60kg, SCr 2.2, CKD4, CrCl ~25): dabigatran 150 mg -> 75 mg BID (labeled dose for CrCl 15-30).
- pt-2011 Whitfield (78y, 68kg, SCr 1.5, CrCl ~39): edoxaban 60 mg -> 30 mg once daily.
- pt-2012 Mercer (68y F, 88kg, SCr 1.0, CrCl ~75): rivaroxaban underdosed; 15 mg -> 20 mg once daily with evening meal.
- pt-2014 Rhodes (72y, 85kg, SCr 1.2, CrCl ~67) on dronedarone: dabigatran underdosed; 75 mg -> 150 mg BID (the 75 mg reduction applies only at CrCl 30-50).
- pt-2015 Lindqvist (79y, 58kg, SCr 1.0): only 1 reduction criterion (weight); apixaban 2.5 mg -> 5 mg BID.
- pt-2016 Quinn (82y F, 125 lb = 56.7 kg): 2 reduction criteria (age >=80, weight <=60 kg); apixaban 5 mg -> 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2017 Doyle (76y F, 61kg, SCr 1.05, CrCl ~44): rivaroxaban 20 mg -> 15 mg once daily with evening meal.

NO CHANGE (correct per label):
- pt-2005 Voss: apixaban 2.5 mg BID (age 83 + weight 57 kg = 2 criteria).
- pt-2006 Lee: rivaroxaban 20 mg daily (CrCl ~89).
- pt-2010 Tran: edoxaban 60 mg daily (CrCl ~92, below the >95 cutoff).
- pt-2013 Ward: edoxaban 60 mg daily (CrCl ~75; the <=60 kg weight-based 30 mg reduction applies to the DVT/PE indication, not NVAF).

No other medications were altered. Note for the clinic: the dronedarone and interacting antimicrobials were left in place as instructed; pt-2008's apixaban dose should be reassessed at the end of the clarithromycin course.

Reviewed all 17 panel patients; all are on a DOAC for nonvalvular AF (ICD-10 I48.91). For each I calculated Cockcroft-Gault CrCl from current age, weight and creatinine (Sept 2026 values) and checked interacting drugs.

CHANGED (13):
- pt-2001 Brooks (62 y, 104 kg, Cr 0.7, CrCl ~161): edoxaban not to be used when CrCl >95 → stopped edoxaban 60 mg daily, started apixaban 5 mg BID (no reduction criteria met).
- pt-2002 Raman (74 F, 52 kg, Cr 1.4, CrCl ~29): rivaroxaban 20 → 15 mg daily.
- pt-2003 Novak (78, Cr 1.7, CrCl ~40) on dronedarone: dabigatran 150 → 75 mg BID (CrCl 30-50 + P-gp inhibitor).
- pt-2004 Greene (81, 88 kg, current Cr 1.2): only 1 apixaban reduction criterion → 2.5 → 5 mg BID.
- pt-2007 Castillo on itraconazole: apixaban 5 → 2.5 mg BID (combined P-gp/strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, 50% reduction).
- pt-2008 Hale on clarithromycin: apixaban 5 → 2.5 mg BID (same interaction; resume 5 mg BID after course ends).
- pt-2009 Soto (75, 60 kg, Cr 2.2, CrCl ~25, CKD4): dabigatran 150 → 75 mg BID.
- pt-2011 Whitfield (78, 68 kg, Cr 1.5, CrCl ~39): edoxaban 60 → 30 mg daily.
- pt-2012 Mercer (68 F, 88 kg, Cr 1.0, CrCl ~75): rivaroxaban 15 → 20 mg daily (underdosed).
- pt-2014 Rhodes (72, Cr 1.2, CrCl ~67) on dronedarone: dabigatran 75 → 150 mg BID (no reduction needed when CrCl >50).
- pt-2015 Lindqvist (79, 58 kg, Cr 1.0): only 1 criterion → apixaban 2.5 → 5 mg BID.
- pt-2016 Quinn (82, 125 lb = 56.7 kg): 2 criteria → apixaban 5 → 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2017 Doyle (76 F, 61 kg, Cr 1.05, CrCl ~44): rivaroxaban 20 → 15 mg daily.

NO CHANGE (4): pt-2005 (apixaban 2.5 BID correct: age 83 + 57 kg), pt-2006 (rivaroxaban 20, CrCl ~89), pt-2010 (edoxaban 60, CrCl ~92, i.e. ≤95), pt-2013 (edoxaban 60, CrCl ~75; no weight-based reduction in AF).

No other medications were altered. Rivaroxaban doses should be taken with the evening meal; recheck renal function per clinic protocol, and restore apixaban 5 mg BID for pt-2007/pt-2008 when the interacting agent is discontinued.
